decisions.rationale: id has null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 10760 exactly equal to row_count 10760, so the cast runway_id uniquely identifies every row in bronze.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 10760, so no exact duplicates exist in bronze and no dedupe pass is applied.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata: true and carry no business meaning (_airbyte_meta is constantly '{}'), so all three are dropped.
lighted and closed landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but contain only the distinct values 0.0 and 1.0 with null_rate 0.0, so both are cast to BOOLEAN.

id and airport_ref landed as VARCHAR with all-integral samples; length_ft, width_ft, le/he_elevation_ft, and le/he_displaced_threshold_ft landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with all-integral samples and bounds, so each is cast to INTEGER.

le_displaced_threshold_ft (null_rate 0.884201) and he_displaced_threshold_ft (null_rate 0.899907) are very sparsely populated but carry valid measurements where present, so nulls are retained and no rows are dropped or imputed.
le/he latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns have null_rates between 0.220911 and 0.276301; nulls are retained rather than imputed or filtered.

surface has 239 inconsistent free-text codings (e.g. 'ASP', 'ASPH', 'ASP/CONC') and le_ident/he_ident include irregular values ('-12', '.', '-'); normalization is deferred, values pass through as VARCHAR.
he_heading_degt has max 362.0, above the valid 0-360 degree range; the value is retained unmodified so a reviewer can decide on a range rule.

purpose: Cleaned runway reference data from OurAirports: one row per runway (grain runway_id) covering 10760 runways at 7591 airports, with typed dimensions, boolean lighted/closed flags, and low-end (le_) and high-end (he_) runway-end coordinates, elevations, headings, and displaced thresholds. Feeds airport infrastructure analytics and joins to the airports silver table via airport_ref or airport_ident.
usage: Join to airports on airport_ref (integer) or airport_ident (string). Filter closed = FALSE for active runways and lighted = TRUE for lit runways. Runway-end geometry columns (le_/he_ latitude, longitude, elevation, heading) are null for roughly 22-28% of rows and displaced thresholds are null for roughly 88-90% of rows, so consumers must handle nulls explicitly; surface is unnormalized free text and should not be used for exact-match grouping without mapping.
limitations: No normalization was applied to surface (239 inconsistent codings) or to the irregular le_ident/he_ident values such as '-12', '.', and '-'. he_heading_degt contains at least one value above 360 (max 362.0) that was retained uncorrected. le_displaced_threshold_ft and he_displaced_threshold_ft are null for 88.4% and 90.0% of rows respectively, and runway-end coordinates are null for about 22% of rows; none of these nulls were imputed. Integer casts for length, width, elevation, and displaced-threshold columns rely on all profiled samples being integral; non-integral outliers outside the sample would fail the cast and surface at build time.
